name: Standing Band Hip Abduction
description: Strengthens the muscles on the outside of the hips for better balance: with a band around both ankles, lift one straight leg out to the side.

source.title: British Heart Foundation: resistance band exercises
source.note: Standing version. The article also shows each exercise seated on a chair.

setup: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Wrap a looped band, or tie a band, around both ankles.
cues: Keep the lifting leg straight with the foot pointed.
Hold a wall or chair back if you feel wobbly.

prescription.note: Aim for 2 to 3 sessions a week with a rest day between. If you have a heart condition or high blood pressure, check with your doctor or cardiac rehab team first.

keyframes.name: Stand
keyframes.cue: Feet hip-width apart, band around your ankles.

keyframes.name: Lift out
keyframes.cue: Lift your right leg out to the side, leg straight, foot pointed.
